about.heading: About Putria
about.bio: I am a student at SMA Muhammadiyah Gombong (Class of 2026) focusing on natural sciences and mathematics. Through roles as General Treasurer in student leadership, project leader in organic waste recycling, and editor for junior high school science materials, I have built practical experience in financial oversight, risk planning, and event coordination. Based in Kebumen, I communicate in Javanese and English and enjoy bringing order, precision, and care to team initiatives.
